_comment: Candidate sounds for public/sounds/, one entry per file. 'page' is the human-readable source page; the script reads the audio URL and the credit line out of it rather than hard-coding a CDN path, because those paths move. 'credit' is what the page must say: only a recording credited to the agency itself is in the public domain. A recording credited to an outside person is that person's copyright and is rejected. Run scripts/fetch-sounds.mjs to check or fetch.

nps.name: US National Park Service, sound gallery
nps.licence: Public domain (work of the US federal government)
nps.licenceNote: The gallery states the files are in the public domain and asks for credit. The NPS also warns that some content on its site is held by third parties, so a file is only accepted when the credit line leads with NPS. A credit of the form 'NPS / Name' is a staff recording and therefore a federal work; a credit that merely mentions NPS after an outside name is that person's copyright.

entries.name: Stream
entries.why: Tier 1 gap: 12 of 16 surveyed apps ship a stream or creek, this one did not.

rejectedEntries.rejected: 2026-09-15: the source page serves audio but carries no credit line, so the recording cannot be confirmed as the agency own work. Look for a CC0 gull on Freesound instead (391 CC0 results, 270 of them soundscapes).
